description: This file is a shell script used for testing rename detection in the diff engine of Git. It sets up test cases, runs Git commands, and verifies rename detection functionality.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs commands, and checks output.

methods.name: compare_diff_patch
methods.description: Compares the current diff output with an expected patch.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in the output.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes multiple lines to a file.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock for timestamp purposes.
